title: Hybridization Chain Reaction (HCR) Protocol for Gastruloids
author: Stefano D Vianello
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bcwfixbn

steps.title: Precoat well and fix gastruloids
steps.instruction: Prepare the well, fix the gastruloids, and keep them overnight at 4 °C.

substeps.instruction: Precoat a well of a 6‑well plate with 2 mL PBSFT (PBS + 10 % FBS + 0.2 % Triton‑X100) for ~30 min.
Remove serum solution and add 2 mL 4 % formaldehyde (prepare by diluting 1.08 mL 37 % formaldehyde to 10 mL with PBS).
Using a cut P1000 pipette, pick each gastruloid from its 96‑well plate and collect all into a 15 mL Falcon tube.
After the gastruloids sediment, remove as much medium as possible with a glass pipette attached to a vacuum line.
Add 2 mL PBS, transfer the gastruloids to the PFA‑filled well, and incubate overnight (~16 h) at 4 °C with gentle shaking (use a fume hood and PPE).

steps.title: Wash with PBST
steps.instruction: Wash samples twice with PBST (0.1 % Tween‑20 in 1× PBS), 5 min each.

steps.title: Dehydrate through graded methanol series
steps.instruction: Perform sequential methanol/PBST washes: 25 % MeOH/75 % PBST 5 min, 50 % MeOH/50 % PBST 5 min, 75 % MeOH/25 % PBST 5 min, 100 % MeOH 5 min, repeat 100 % MeOH 5 min.

steps.title: Store at -20 °C overnight
steps.instruction: Incubate samples at –20 °C overnight (≈16 h) or until use.

steps.title: Rehydrate through graded methanol series
steps.instruction: Rehydrate samples (max 500 µL per tube) with the reverse series: 100 % MeOH 5 min, 75 % MeOH/25 % PBST 5 min, 50 % MeOH/50 % PBST 5 min, 25 % MeOH/75 % PBST 5 min, 100 % PBST 5 min, repeat 100 % PBST 5 min.

steps.title: Proteinase K digestion
steps.instruction: Treat samples with 25 µg/mL Proteinase K for 4 min at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a 50 µg/mL Proteinase K solution by diluting 1.37 µL of 18.25 mg/mL Proteinase K (Merck, CAS 38450‑01‑6) in 500 µL PBST.
Remove half of the sample volume and add an equal volume of the 50 µg/mL solution to obtain a final concentration of 25 µg/mL.
Incubate for 4 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Post‑digestion PBST washes
steps.instruction: Wash samples twice with PBST, 5 min each.

steps.title: Re‑fix and pre‑warm PH buffer
steps.instruction: Refix samples in 4 % formaldehyde for 20 min at room temperature and pre‑warm probe‑hybridization (PH) buffer.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 4 % formaldehyde by diluting 2.16 mL 37 % formaldehyde to 20 mL with PBST; add 2 mL to each sample for 20 min at RT.
Pre‑warm 1.5 mL PH buffer per sample at 37 °C for later use.

steps.title: PBST washes after re‑fixation
steps.instruction: Wash samples three times with PBST, 5 min each.

steps.title: PH buffer wash and pellet
steps.instruction: Wash samples with PH buffer for 5 min, then centrifuge at 1500 × g for 1 min at room temperature to pellet gastruloids.

steps.title: Incubate in PH buffer and prepare probe mix
steps.instruction: Incubate gastruloids in fresh PH buffer for 30 min at 37 °C while preparing the probe solution.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 µL fresh PH buffer to the pellet and incubate 30 min at 37 °C.
Prepare probe solution: add 4 pmol odd‑probe mixture and 4 pmol even‑probe mixture (2 µL of 2 µM stock each, total 4 µL) to the 500 µL PH buffer to obtain a final probe concentration of 8 nM.

steps.title: Hybridize probes overnight (include controls)
steps.instruction: Reserve part of the samples as negative controls, replace PH buffer with probe solution, and incubate overnight (~16 h) at 37 °C.

steps.title: Pre‑warm wash and amplification buffers
steps.instruction: Pre‑warm probe wash buffer (2 mL per tube) at 37 °C and equilibrate amplification buffer (1 mL per tube) to room temperature.

steps.title: Prepare hairpin mixture (snap‑cool)
steps.instruction: Prepare 48 pmol of each hairpin in 500 µL and snap‑cool.

substeps.instruction: For each 500 µL reaction, add 16 µL of 3 µM hairpin h1 (48 pmol) and 16 µL of 3 µM hairpin h2 (48 pmol).
Heat the mixture at 95 °C for 1 min 30 sec, then cool at room temperature in the dark for at least 30 min (final hairpin concentration 96 nM).

steps.title: Probe wash series at 37 °C
steps.instruction: Wash samples with probe wash buffer at 37 °C four times, 15 min each (hairpin preparation may be started during this wash).

steps.title: Wash with 5× SSCT (prepare solution)
steps.instruction: Wash samples twice with 5× SSCT (0.1 % Tween‑20) at room temperature, 5 min each.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 5× SSCT by diluting 125 mL 20× SSC and 0.5 mL Tween‑20 to 500 mL with distilled water.

steps.title: Amplification buffer wash
steps.instruction: Wash samples with the pre‑equilibrated amplification buffer for 5 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Add hairpins, DAPI, and incubate overnight
steps.instruction: Add hairpin mixture and DAPI (2 µg/mL) to samples and incubate overnight in the dark at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge samples at 1500 × g for 30 s at RT, remove amplification buffer.
Add the snap‑cooled hairpin mixture.
Add DAPI to a final concentration of 2 µg/mL (1:500 dilution of a 1 mg/mL stock).
Incubate overnight in the dark at RT (shorter incubation for dHCR imaging).

steps.title: Wash with 5× SSCT (30 min dark)
steps.instruction: Wash samples with 5× SSCT for 30 min in the dark at room temperature.

steps.title: DAPI nuclear stain and washes
steps.instruction: Stain nuclei with DAPI 1:1000 (2 µg/mL) in the dark at room temperature, then wash three times, 25 min each.

steps.title: Final 5× SSCT washes
steps.instruction: Wash samples twice with 5× SSCT in the dark at room temperature, 15 min each.

steps.title: Optional fructose‑glycerol clearing
steps.instruction: Incubate samples in fructose‑glycerol clearing solution at 4 °C in the dark for ≥2 h.

substeps.instruction: Prepare clearing solution by dissolving 29.72 g fructose in 33 mL glycerol and 7 mL water; stir on a magnetic stirrer (start at least one day before use).
Store the solution in the dark at 4 °C for up to 1 month.

steps.title: Mount samples for imaging
steps.instruction: Mount gastruloids in Fluoromount‑G, cover, and seal for microscopy.

substeps.instruction: Transfer gastruloids to a 35 µL drop of Fluoromount‑G using a cut P1000 pipette.
Place a #1 coverslip on top, wick excess liquid with a Kimtech wipe, and seal all edges with Permount.
